review.notes: Full review of all 13 kept targets and the 5 Suggested.lean statements. Every Check and worked example recomputed; tan Theta theorems tested numerically (4,210 random cases). Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry warnings only; signatures match the README. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks: all passed, none set aside. Sources: Yu-Wang-Samworth (arXiv 1405.0680), Albeverio-Makarov-Motovilov (math/0105142) and Seelmann (1310.2036) read; Davis-Kahan 1970, Rosenblum 1956 and Bhatia-Davis-McIntosh 1983 not legally readable. Findings: R01 credits the sharp pi/2 constant to Bhatia-Davis-McIntosh, contradicted by AMM Remark 2.8; R02 gives no target a locator and no publication for the Haagerup-Zsido reference.
